svg.text: Chart #3 (14 x 31 cells): the two fold lines cross six K4 cells and 22 K3 cells
Restarting one key at the six crossings puts five crib pairs at the same phase: 28/71, 29/72, 30/73, 32/63, 33/64.
A shift table (6 conventions) needs equal keys in each pair: K4 disagrees in all 5 (closed, for any key generator).
Arbitrary rows by phase: K4 has 0 conflicts, but so do 83% of 100,000 shuffled ciphertexts (undecidable).
Cell layout only; the public image is a typeset reconstruction, and every other mark lies outside the grid.
